--- note
Promoted from matrix cell md/table/plain/w80/desktop (FINDINGS.md #3, rule R-V2).
The table document needs literal pipes, so this fixture uses the numeric caret sections: start at offset 18 (column 18 of the top line), expect offset 82 (column 18 of the bottom line).
The first Down crosses the rendered table in one press and lands at the far side's line start by design (R-V7, offset 63, the blank line); the SECOND press must aim back at the run's goal column.
Before the fix, tableArrowKeymap's crossing dispatched without the vertical-motion session bookkeeping, the goal re-captured at the col-0 landing, and the caret continued at column 0 forever.
